transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Vikram. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Vikram, I'm really frustrated. My phone has been dropping calls constantly for the week and I'm just tired of it.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing these connectivity issues, Rahul. I can certainly help you look into this.
Agent: Before we dive into the account details, could you please provide your account number and date of birth for verification?
Customer: Sure, my account number is 38491325 and my date of birth is 22/02/1970. My name is Rahul Das.
Agent: Thank you for the verification. Now, about the phone, have you tried restarting the device?
Customer: Yes, I've tried everything. I think the device is faulty. I'm just going to cancel my service and switch to another provider.
Agent: I'm sorry to see you go, Rahul. I promise this will never happen again.
Agent: Regarding the cancellation, there is no early-termination fee for your current plan, and your final bill will arrive within thirty days of the closing date.
Agent: I can process the cancellation request for you right now so you'll be able to port out your number 96070 12857.
Agent: However, if you've decided to stay, I can book a device check for you with our technical team to see if it's a hardware issue.
Customer: I'll take the device check, but I'm still leaning towards leaving. Let's see if that helps first.
Agent: Perfect. I have scheduled that check. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Your cancellation request is on hold and the device check is arranged. Goodbye!
